# wxone_securityGroupAssociation (Resource)

Manages a securityGroupAssociation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project in UUID format.
- `security_group_id` (String) ID of the security group in UUID format.

### Optional

- `subnet_id` (String) ID of the subnet in UUID format (not yet supported)
- `vm_id` (String) ID of the vm in UUID format.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the securityGroupAssociation in UUID format.
